title: Tom Has a Cold
text:
Tom has a cold. He feels tired and his head hurts. He stays in bed all day. He drinks warm tea.

The next day, Tom goes to the doctor. The doctor looks at his throat. She says Tom needs rest and water. Tom feels better after three days.

questions.text: Who does Tom go to see the next day?
Why does Tom stay in bed all day?
options: He needs to rest to get better
He is waiting for a bus

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel about the doctor?

vocabulary.definition: an illness that makes your nose run and your throat sore
a person who works to help sick people
the inside part of your neck that you use to swallow
time when you do nothing so that your body can recover

paragraph_translations: Tom tiene un resfriado. Se siente cansado y le duele la cabeza. Se queda en la cama todo el día. Bebe té caliente.
Al día siguiente, Tom va al médico. La doctora le mira la garganta. Ella dice que Tom necesita descanso y agua. Tom se siente mejor después de tres días.
